task.title: Attaching referrers to an image tag
task.shortdesc: To attach referrers to an image tag in Red Hat Quay, you can use the oras CLI with OCI distribution spec 1.1 referrers schemas.

ul.li: You have downloaded the oras CLI.
You have access to an OCI media artifact.

context.p: This procedure shows you how to attach referrers to an image tag using different schemas supported by the OCI distribution spec 1.1 using the oras CLI. This is useful for attaching and managing additional metadata like referrers to container images.
